intent: Implement only after explicit gates a reusable natural real-time voice and grounded text chat capability, validated locally with disposable generated-project fixtures, with cloud-portable per-subscription discovery and external processing separately gated; Azure Government remains the deployment-test target; no commit, push, deployment, or publication is included.

steps.action: Inspect current capability reuse, duplication, ownership, profiles, and dependencies; decide whether candidate skill ID live-chat-interaction is needed without authoring it.
completionCriteria: Existing skills are mapped to every requested responsibility and no current conversational-runtime owner is assumed without evidence.
Reuse is selected when sufficient; otherwise live-chat-interaction is recorded as the exact nonduplicate candidate, with no authoring yet.
steps.rollback: Preserve the prior validated inventory and discard only the candidate assessment.
steps.recovery: Refresh missing ownership evidence and rerun inventory; if ambiguity remains, stop at STEP-020.

steps.action: Define local-first contracts for client microphone and transcript state, server session isolation, asynchronous streaming, VAD and end-of-turn adapters, grounding, cancellation, reconnect, half-duplex baseline, and future barge-in extension.
outputs: Conversation, transport, grounding, adapter, cancellation, and reconnect contracts
completionCriteria: Browser, server session, adapters, and versioned grounding sources have separate contracts and trust boundaries.

Natural half-duplex uses live transcript, tunable silence endpointing, automatic informational submission, correction or cancellation, streaming response, and listening resume; barge-in remains an extension.
steps.rollback: Reject the candidate architecture and retain existing framework boundaries.
steps.recovery: Resolve ambiguous state or trust boundaries and repeat architecture review before STEP-003.

steps.action: Threat-model consent and privacy, prompt injection, output safety, audio and transcript retention, auth and RBAC, rate limits, abuse, redacted telemetry, browser permission, and server secrets.
outputs: Testable privacy, safety, identity, retention, validation, and abuse controls
completionCriteria: Notice and consent precede microphone or cloud use; raw audio is not retained and transcripts default to session-only.
Untrusted input, retrieval, and output are validated; content safety, least privilege, server secrets, redacted structured logs, retries, rate limits, health, and metrics are required.
steps.rollback: Discard the candidate threat model without changing runtime or policy state.
steps.recovery: Carry unresolved safe-default decisions to STEP-005 or stop at STEP-020.

steps.action: Simulate silence, noise, false endpointing, interruption, denied microphone, model or Speech unavailability, reconnect, stale grounding, approval rejection, costs, and fallback without mutation.
completionCriteria: Every named failure has a deterministic user-visible transition to correction, cancellation, reconnect, text or guided fallback, or handoff.
Approval rejection and cost limits never imply consequential submission or external authorization.
steps.rollback: Discard simulated state; repository and external state remain unchanged.
steps.recovery: Repair incomplete architecture or control routes and rerun simulation before STEP-005.

steps.action: Approve the exact new-skill, runtime, template, schema, test, docs, UX-default, and threshold boundary, including explicit skill-create proceed authorization; no implementation starts before this gate.
outputs: Explicit skill-create --proceed approval or reuse-only decision
Frozen deterministic UX and evaluation thresholds
completionCriteria: Approval names the exact skill/runtime/template/schema/test/docs boundary and confirms no permanent demo app in the Launch Pad.
Approval freezes endpoint, latency, correction, grounding, citation, unknown, accessibility, privacy, cost, and fallback thresholds and separately satisfies skill-create proceed when needed.
Commit, push, Azure discovery, external processing, provisioning, deployment, publication, and release remain excluded.
steps.rollback: Withdraw approval before implementation; the gate changes no source.
steps.recovery: Record rejection or narrowing and stop at STEP-020; never infer approval.

steps.action: After STEP-005, compare inventory again and author live-chat-interaction only if reuse remains insufficient; otherwise record the owner and avoid duplication.
outputs: Governed skill package or documented reuse decision
Catalog, help, profile, dependency, routing, tests, and docs propagation when created
completionCriteria: A new complete governed skill is created only after explicit proceed and renewed proof that no current owner suffices.
When created, catalog/help/profile/dependency/routing/tests/docs stay acyclic and dependency-closed; otherwise no duplicate is added.
steps.rollback: Remove only the new skill and approved companions, or retain the reuse decision.
steps.recovery: Correct duplication or contract failures and repeat skill validation before STEP-007.

steps.action: Red-green a pure conversation state machine with interim transcript, configurable silence endpoint, automatic informational submission, explicit action confirmation, correction, cancellation, no raw-audio retention, and half-duplex listening resume using local doubles.
outputs: Fake VAD, speech, response, clock, and cancellation adapters
completionCriteria: Informational voice turns need no manual submit; consequential actions require explicit confirmation.
Live transcript, tunable pause, false-endpoint correction/cancel, session-only transcript, no raw audio, spoken-response opt-in, and listening resume pass deterministic tests.
steps.rollback: Remove only this implementation slice and its tests.
steps.recovery: Keep the smallest failing transition test, repair it, and rerun the focused suite.

steps.action: Red-green grounding over versioned approved docs and capability metadata with source links, explicit unknowns, prompt-injection boundaries, stale-source handling, and output validation.
outputs: Citation, unknown, stale-source, injection, and validation tests
completionCriteria: Answers cite approved source links and corpus versions or explicitly state unknown.
Retrieved instructions cannot override policy; stale, malformed, or absent sources fail to unknown or guided fallback.
steps.rollback: Remove grounding changes and restore the passing STEP-007 checkpoint.
steps.recovery: Reduce to one source or injection case, repair it, and rerun focused tests.

steps.action: Validate the server-side transport, asynchronous streaming, session, and auth boundary with local fake adapters and no browser credentials.
outputs: Fake streaming, auth, retry, health, and failure adapters
completionCriteria: No service credential or privileged token enters browser code.
Session isolation, streaming cancellation, reconnect, retries/backoff, rate signaling, health, metrics, and fallback run locally without cloud or billable services.
steps.rollback: Remove transport scaffolding and retain passing pure components.
steps.recovery: Repair local boundary gaps with fake adapters and repeat readiness validation.

steps.action: Build an accessible responsive fixture only in a disposable generated project for microphone, listening, transcribing, thinking, speaking, correction, cancellation, denied, unavailable, error, text, and guided states.
outputs: Keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, responsive, text, and guided fallback tests
completionCriteria: All interaction and failure states are perceivable, responsive, and operable by keyboard and screen reader with reduced motion.
Only approved reusable shipped assets remain; no permanent app or demo project is created inside the Launch Pad.
steps.rollback: Delete the fixture and remove only approved reusable assets from this slice.
steps.recovery: Reproduce the failing UI state, repair the owning asset, and rerun accessibility tests.

steps.action: Perform the local security/change checkpoint and full local repository gate before any Azure discovery request.
outputs: Focused tests and npm run check evidence
completionCriteria: No critical or high security, privacy, auth, injection, secret, retention, or abuse issue remains.
The bounded diff matches STEP-005 and focused tests plus npm run check pass.
steps.rollback: Preserve the last passing local checkpoint; review is nonmutating.
steps.recovery: Return findings to their owner, repair, and repeat STEP-011.

steps.action: Approve read-only discovery in the saved Azure Commercial or Azure Government cloud for one named subscription, excluding provisioning, model selection, billable processing, deployment, and application-data transfer.
inputs: Exact named subscription and read-only discovery scope
outputs: Explicit cloud and subscription discovery approval or rejection
Approved subscription, cloud, and read-only boundary
completionCriteria: Approval identifies the saved Azure cloud, named subscription, and read-only scope without authorizing creation or billing.
No audio, transcript, corpus, prompt, user, or fixture data is sent; cloud mismatch or invalid context stops at STEP-020 without silent cross-cloud fallback.
Azure Government is recorded as the required deployment-test target even when discovery occurs in another approved cloud.
steps.rollback: Withdraw approval before discovery; the gate changes no resource.
steps.recovery: Record denial or missing prerequisites and stop at STEP-020.

steps.action: If approved, read-only discover the selected cloud and subscription's Speech and chat-model availability, regions, quota, cost indicators, identity, data boundaries, cloud endpoints, and supported SDK/REST API versions without selecting a model or creating resources.
inputs: Selected cloud and subscription auth context
outputs: Region, quota, cost, identity, data-boundary, and fallback findings
completionCriteria: Discovery is read-only in the selected cloud and subscription, with no resource, reservation, deployment, or inference creation.
Evidence includes service, model, region, quota, cost indicator, cloud endpoint, SDK/REST API version, auth/RBAC feasibility, and data boundary; no model is selected.
Azure Government availability is separately recorded for deployment testing; denied or unavailable capability preserves local fallback and stops at STEP-020.
steps.rollback: Discard stale discovery output; no Azure rollback is required for read-only work.
steps.recovery: Correct the approved Government context and retry, or stop with local fallback evidence.

steps.action: Separately approve any billable model or Speech external-processing implementation and required provisioning; discovery is not approval and deployment remains excluded.
inputs: Frozen privacy, data, cost, quota, identity, and evaluation boundaries
outputs: Explicit external-processing and privileged phase approval or rejection
Exact allowed cloud, subscription, services, API versions, data classes, identity, cost, and retention scope
completionCriteria: Approval names Government services, data classes, retention, cost ceiling, resource scope, and least-privilege identity.
No approval is inferred; rejection or waiting stops at STEP-020, and commit, push, deployment, publication, and release stay excluded.
steps.rollback: Withdraw approval before provisioning or external implementation.
steps.recovery: Record rejection, narrowing, or waiting and stop at STEP-020.

steps.action: After STEP-014 only, integrate the approved cloud-specific server adapter selected from the compatibility matrix with DefaultAzureCredential or managed identity, least-privilege RBAC, streaming, retries/backoff, safety, redacted telemetry, rate limits, health, and metrics; Azure Government remains the deployment-test target.
inputs: STEP-013 discovery and API compatibility matrix
outputs: Identity, streaming, retry, safety, telemetry, rate, health, and fallback tests
completionCriteria: DefaultAzureCredential or managed identity and least-privilege RBAC keep credentials out of browser and logs.
Async streaming, cancellation, bounded retries, content safety, input/output validation, redacted logs, rate limits, health, metrics, and fallback pass within the approved scope.
steps.rollback: Disable the Azure adapter and remove only resources explicitly covered by the approved rollback while retaining local adapters.
steps.recovery: Fail closed to local text or guided mode and stop at STEP-020 on identity, safety, cost, or sovereignty failure.

steps.action: Evaluate latency, endpoint accuracy, transcript correction, grounding quality, citations, unknowns, injection, security, accessibility, cost, and fallback against thresholds frozen at STEP-005 before rollout consideration.
outputs: Deterministic quality, security, accessibility, latency, grounding, cost, and fallback evidence
completionCriteria: Endpointing, correction, cancellation, latency, resume, grounding, citations, unknowns, injection, safety, privacy, and accessibility meet frozen thresholds.
Cost ceiling, rate limits, retries, unavailable-service behavior, and text/guided fallback pass before any rollout claim.
steps.rollback: Reject the candidate at the last passing checkpoint; evaluation performs no rollout.
steps.recovery: Return failed metrics to their implementation owner and rerun the frozen suite.

steps.action: Update authoritative guides, runbooks, privacy notices, retention, configuration, corpus versioning, fallback, health, metrics, and troubleshooting using verified evidence only.
inputs: Verified local and approved Government behavior
outputs: Privacy, retention, configuration, fallback, and corpus procedures
completionCriteria: Docs distinguish local fakes from approved Government processing and make consent, session-only transcript, no raw audio, spoken opt-in, action confirmation, and server secrets clear.
Configuration, corpus versions, accessibility, retries, rates, health, metrics, recovery, and limitations match evidence.
steps.rollback: Restore prior docs when corresponding behavior is withdrawn.
steps.recovery: Correct claims against tests and rerun docs and repository validation.

steps.action: Review the bounded LIVE-CHAT-001 diff for defects, requirement gaps, privacy and auth regressions, unsafe external behavior, unsupported claims, missing tests, and Launch Pad boundary violations.
completionCriteria: No critical or high defect, security/privacy gap, unauthorized external action, or boundary violation remains.
All acceptance criteria and changed contracts have evidence; no commit, push, deployment, publication, release, or unapproved Azure action occurred.
steps.rollback: Review is read-only; preserve prior valid evidence.
steps.recovery: Repair each finding at its owner, rerun validation, and repeat review.

steps.action: Prepare the minimal validated candidate boundary and commit summary without staging, committing, pushing, deploying, publishing, or releasing.
completionCriteria: Every path maps to STEP-005 and unrelated work is excluded.
Tests, evaluation, review, and npm run check are current; no staging, commit, push, deployment, publication, or release occurs.
steps.rollback: Discard only preparation output and preserve implementation and user changes.
steps.recovery: Return to STEP-018 whenever candidate or evidence changes.

steps.action: Publish the single terminal handoff for completed, blocked, failed, denied, or waiting outcomes with prior workflow lineage and exactly one next action.
inputs: Approval, blocker, fallback, cost, and risk evidence
completionCriteria: Handoff distinguishes planning, local work, Azure discovery, external processing, and candidate preparation without implying later gates.
Prior safe-update and P4 workflows remain append-only history and exactly one next action is recorded without claiming commit, push, deployment, publication, or release.
steps.rollback: Preserve the last valid handoff and regenerate mutable views from accepted evidence.
steps.recovery: Rebuild continuity from the latest checkpoint and append-only history.
